audio.filter: Filter voices by language or name
audio.sampleRo: La început, Dumnezeu a creat cerul și pământul. Dragostea este răbdătoare și plină de bunătate.

audio.windowsOpened: Windows speech settings opened. Voice installation is managed there.
audio.voicesHelp: Preview an available voice or download a Piper voice for offline use. Windows voices and bundled eSpeak voices are listed as actually available.
audio.closeCancels: Closing this window cancels an active voice download.
audio.scopeHelp: Selected words remain the exact selected text. Chapters and books are read one verse at a time in the selected edition.
audio.failed: Audio could not be prepared. Check the selected voice and try again.
audio.noSelection: Select text or a verse to read aloud.
audio.noText: No source text is available for this reading.
audio.textTooLong: This passage is too long for one audio clip. Select a shorter passage.
audio.invalidRange: Choose the last verse or chapter at or after the first.
audio.confirmRemove: Remove the downloaded voice {voice}? Bible text and personal notes are preserved.
audio.state.ready: Audio ready. Press Play to listen.
audio.state.error: Playback stopped. Check the voice or try again.
audio.error.VOICE_NOT_INSTALLED_OR_CORRU: Install or reinstall the selected voice in Voice Manager.
audio.error.VOICE_NOT_AVAILABLE: This voice is no longer available. Refresh the voice list.
audio.error.VOICE_PRESENT_BUT_INVALID: Remove this incomplete voice before downloading it again.
audio.error.AUDIO_BUSY: Another audio operation is finishing. Try again shortly.
audio.error.PROVIDER_BUSY: Another speech process is finishing. Try again shortly.
audio.error.SYNTHESIS_TIMEOUT: The voice took too long. Try a shorter passage.
audio.error.VOICE_DOWNLOAD_INTEGRITY_FAI: The voice download did not pass its integrity check. It was not installed.
audio.error.VOICE_DOWNLOAD_SIZE_MISMATCH: The downloaded voice has an unexpected size and was not installed.
audio.error.PROVIDER_FAILED: The selected speech engine could not generate audio.
audio.error.AUDIO_CACHE_BUDGET_BLOCKED: The audio cache is full or in use. Stop playback and try a shorter passage.
audio.error.UNEXPECTED_VOICE_FILES: The voice folder contains other files, which were preserved.
audio.error.WINDOWS_SPEECH_UNAVAILABLE: Windows speech is unavailable on this installation.
audio.error.ESPEAK_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE: The bundled eSpeak NG engine is unavailable.
audio.error.INVALID_TEXT: Select a nonempty passage of at most 25,000 characters.
audio.error.INVALID_SPEED: Choose a speaking speed between 0.5 and 2.
audio.savedVoiceUnavailable: The saved voice is unavailable. An installed voice has been selected.
audio.androidOpened: Android speech settings opened. Device voices are managed there.
audio.androidVoicesHelp: Piper and eSpeak voices bundled with Ultimate work offline. Android device voices are listed only when discovered; voices marked as requiring a network may not work offline.
audio.engineCount: Installed TTS engines discovered: {count}. Install the Romanian Voice Add-on if no local Romanian voice is available, then refresh.
audio.runtimeNotTested: Bundled files are verified. Test this voice to check its runtime on this device.
audio.error.NO_ROMANIAN_VOICE: No installed Romanian voice is available in this mode. Choose a compatible engine or install the Romanian Voice Add-on, then refresh.
audio.error.NO_COMPATIBLE_VOICE: No installed voice matches this text language and mode. Open Voice Manager.
audio.error.VOICE_LANGUAGE_MISMATCH: The selected voice does not match the text language. Choose a Romanian voice for Romanian Scripture.
audio.error.SPEECH_RECOVERY_FAILED: The compatible speech engines failed. Open Voice Manager, test the Romanian Voice Add-on or choose another installed Romanian engine.
audio.error.AUDIO_PLAYBACK_FAILED: Android could not play this audio. Check media volume and try the Romanian Voice Add-on.
audio.error.AUDIO_PLAYBACK_TIMEOUT: Android playback did not finish. Stop playback and try again.
audio.error.SPEECH_LANGUAGE_REQUIRED: Choose the language and a matching voice before narration.
audio.error.ENGINE_NOT_INSTALLED: That Android TTS engine is not installed. Refresh the engine list or open Android voice settings.
audio.error.ENGINE_INITIALIZATION_FAILED: The selected Android voice engine could not start. Try another installed engine.
